1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is __intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker in a molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1__.

2) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle __further__ intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound __selected from zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, or zirconium acetylacetonate__, [[selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate]].

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle__ comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __50 to 99 nm__ in diameter.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker in a molar ratio of PVS to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1__.

12) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __being intimately associated with__ a multivalent cation.

13) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the amount of PVS exceeds the amount of polyalkylenimine__.

21) (Currently amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1__; wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker in a molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1__; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is __selected from acrylate-based polymers, polyacrylamide, partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate__.

23) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is __selected from partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, polyacrylamide, or copolymers thereof__.

24) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is __selected from copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate__.

26) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where __said__ fluid is __selected from brine or seawater__.
